$comment: Paragraphs that say the same thing twice, and which copy the reader meets second.
RULE 1b, IN FULL: a duplicate is COLLAPSED, not cut. Until Firefly approves deletion, the
second copy stays in the document and stays in the printed kit; it is folded behind a one-line
cross-reference naming the section that said it first. Nothing here removes a word.
WHY THIS LIST IS SHORT. DECISIONS.md D-1 tabled eleven repetitions. Re-derived from the
content by scripts/find-duplicates.mjs, three survive: the restructure and the retirement of
67 ASCII blocks removed the rest. The guard runs the detector on every build and fails if this
file declares a repetition that is gone, or misses one that is there.
WHICH SIDE IS THE DUPLICATE is a reading-order judgement and it is made here rather than by
the detector, which walks the chapters alphabetically. The duplicate is the copy the reader
reaches SECOND in the flow — collapsing the first would point a reader forward at something
they have not read, which is worse than the repetition. Reading order is lib/heading-slug.ts's
